Good question. If you want the best value, the Growth plan is usually the sweet spot.
Here’s the simple way to think about it:
Basic ($179/mo)
Good for getting started. You can build a site, sell products, and run email. But it leaves out tools that help you grow, like affiliates and advanced automations.
Growth ($249/mo)
Adds the tools that help you scale. You get affiliates, advanced automations, cohort courses, and more integrations. These are the features that help you turn one offer into a real business.
Pro ($399/mo)
Built for bigger teams and advanced setups. It includes things like API access, multiple websites, and a branded mobile app. Most new creators don’t need this yet.
Simple rule:
Start with Basic if you’re just testing.
Choose Growth if you want the best balance of price and tools to actually grow.
If you want, I can also walk through what you’d realistically need in your first 6 months. That helps a lot when money is tight.

Short answer: no, you can’t split your Kajabi subscription into installments.
For your plan (Basic, Growth, etc.), billing works like this:
Monthly → pay once per month
Annual → pay once per year (this is where the discount comes in)
There isn’t a built-in option to break that subscription fee into smaller payments.
Installments and “pay later” options (like Klarna or Afterpay) exist, but those are for products you sell to your customers, not for paying your Kajabi plan.
If keeping costs lower upfront matters, the best fit is the monthly plan or the $99 for 3 months option to start.
